Hero.title: Discover the Equipment Behind Innovation
Hero.subtitle: Browse the laboratory equipment available for colleges and students: what each device is, how it is used in the lab, how many units are available, and its estimated market price.

Categories.title: Browse by category
Categories.subtitle: A structured catalogue for laboratories, universities, colleges and engineering teams.
Categories.electronicsDesc: Oscilloscopes, multimeters, signal generators, power supplies and training kits.
Categories.electricalDesc: Electrical measurement, machines, transformers and voltage regulators.
Categories.telecomDesc: Fibre optics, fusion splicers, RF equipment, trainers and telephone systems.
Categories.microscopyDesc: Optical and stereo microscopes, inspection and imaging equipment.
Categories.solderingDesc: Soldering stations, BGA rework, hot-air stations and PCB repair.
Categories.automationDesc: PLC systems, microcontrollers, DSP boards and control systems.
Categories.laboratoryDesc: Ultrasonic cleaners, laboratory supplies, measurement and testing equipment.

Why.title: Why LabSouq?
Why.subtitle: Built for people who need to know exactly what they are buying.
Why.honestDesc: Unknown specifications, condition or prices are shown as "Not provided" — never guessed.
Why.explore3dDesc: Rotate, inspect and take apart equipment where a verified 3D model exists.
Why.bilingualDesc: Every page, product and specification in both languages.
Why.quoteDesc: Institutions can request quotations and compare supplier offers.

How.title: How it works
How.step1Desc: Search the catalogue by name, brand, model or specification.
How.step2Desc: Review photos, specifications, documents and 3D models.
How.step3Desc: Contact the seller or request a quotation.

About.title: About LabSouq
About.lead: LabSouq is a marketplace for new and used scientific, laboratory, educational, electrical, electronic and engineering equipment.
About.body1: We start in Oman and plan to expand to the GCC and international markets. The platform serves universities, colleges, students, laboratories, scientific institutions, engineering companies, equipment suppliers and independent sellers.
About.body2: Our principle is simple: show what is known, and say clearly what is not.
